profile.migration_strategy_justification: Select the exact File Budget-aware built-in workflow definitions for subsequently created items while every existing item keeps its immutable version pin.

invariants: Every selected pre-migration built-in current is an exact code-owned version 1, version 2, or already-converged version 3 definition.
Every built-in workflow selects the exact File Budget-aware code-owned revision after apply.
Existing items retain the same workflow_id and workflow_version_id throughout apply.
Every item workflow pin still resolves to an immutable version owned by the same workflow.
attestation.residual_risk_notes: The migration accepts only exact code-owned v1/v2 current definitions or the exact already-converged v3 definitions, may append the four v3 workflow-version rows, and changes only current pointers used by future item creation. Existing item pins are compared before and after. Overall affected-table row counts are intentionally not preserved because missing immutable v3 definitions are inserted.
